sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Printed page 344 visually preserves the Triebfaktorenverband of the manic state: m−, d0, k−! with −!! as variant, p−, s+! with +!! as variant, h+, e+, hy−. The source separately highlights d0, m−, k−!, s+! as the four most important reactions. Printed page 345 continues their source interpretation. Canonical OCR damages several factor labels and intensity marks, so PDF visual reading governs formulas.

sourceExcerpt: Für den manischen Zustand fanden wir nachfolgenden Triebfaktorenverband charakteristisch:
romanianRendering: Pentru starea maniacală, Szondi formulează un Triebfaktorenverband cu m−, d0, k−! (eventual −!!), p−, s+! (eventual +!!), h+, e+ și hy−; dintre acestea evidențiază d0, m−, k−! și s+! ca reacții principale.
doctrinalStatement: În syndromatica istorică a fazei maniacale, Triebfaktorenverband-ul source-defined este m− / d0 / k−!(−!!) / p− / s+!(+!!) / h+ / e+ / hy−. Sursa evidențiază separat patru reacții principale: d0 / m− / k−! / s+!. Configurația rămâne o structură testologică istorică și nu autorizează diagnosticul autonom al maniei sau reducerea ei la un singur semn precum k−! ori d0.
conditions: Use the exact factor signs and quantum marks visually arbitrated from admitted PDF printed page 344.
Apply only within Szondi's source-defined manisch-depressive syndromatics and its manic phase.
exceptions: Do not infer a contemporary manic episode from this factorsverband alone.
Do not promote k−!, d0, m− or s+! individually to the complete syndrome.
Do not silently normalize the source's quantum variants −!! / +!! to ordinary signs.
scopeNotes: The factor-by-factor source interpretations of Bindung, Suchen, Entwertung and Aktivität remain attached to this syndrome context rather than being serialized as generic person-level claims.

relations.note: Provides the source's compact multi-factor syndrome structure for the manic phase.

ambiguities: Canonical OCR damages the p344 formula block; admitted PDF visually resolves all eight factors and the intensity variants.
